title: Grounded evidence assistant
brief: Build a document QA assistant over 30 versioned, synthetic documents, with access-aware retrieval and supported citations.
build: Version and chunk an explicit corpus with document IDs, timestamps and ACL tags.
Implement lexical and/or semantic retrieval and bounded response generation.
Verify each cited sentence against the retrieved source span.
tests: Injection attempt in a retrieved passage
gate: All restricted-source requests denied; citation support is measured on a fixed test set; provenance and rollback documented.

title: Read-only infrastructure assistant
brief: Design a narrow status/troubleshooting assistant that can inspect a simulated service inventory without executing writes.
build: Specify read-only get_service_status and get_recent_log tools.
Enforce principal-specific service allowlists and resource-level auth.
Use a bounded investigation loop and record complete tool/policy traces.
tests: Prompt injection in a log line
gate: No write capability without separate approval; validated tool schemas, bounded recovery and explicit missing-evidence fallback.

title: Evaluation-driven coding harness
brief: Use an isolated sandbox to propose a small patch, run a predefined test suite, and prepare a human-reviewed diff; never auto-merge.
build: Scope a disposable repository workspace and file access.
Provide read, search, patch and test tools with explicit command allowlists.
Record diffs, test exit codes and decision traces for replay.
gate: Reproducible evaluation, no unauthorized scope changes, explained recovery paths and reviewable final patch.

title: Inference and agent SLO lab
brief: Benchmark two local serving configurations under varied input lengths and concurrency; connect performance to one fixed agent workload.
build: Capture hardware, driver, runtime, weights, tokenizer and template fingerprint.
Instrument TTFT, decode throughput, p50/p95 end-to-end latency and memory.
Compare serving configurations with unchanged workload and acceptance tests.
gate: Versioned benchmark report, p50/p95 charts, quality and memory trade-offs, risk review and verified rollback.
